6,586 likes, 226 comments - chatgptricks on June 14, 2026: "China is rewriting college for AI

China’s universities have cut more than 12,000 degree programs they considered outdated, as the country pushes schools to prepare students for the AI era. The cuts happened between 2021 and 2025, according to official education data.

Many of the removed programs were in fields with weaker job demand, including parts of humanities and management. At the same time, universities are adding AI focused majors and updating courses around intelligent machines.

The shift shows how quickly education is being reshaped by the skills governments believe the next economy will need.

Should more countries do the same?
